title: Connect Glean MCP to your AI tools
description: Point Claude Code, Cursor, and Claude Desktop at your Glean MCP endpoint and run one enterprise task from each — same context, three surfaces.

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
Which installed MCP host should be configured?
What topic do you know exists in your Glean content for verification?

prerequisites: Glean MCP server enabled for your deployment (admin toggle)
At least one MCP host installed (Claude Code, Cursor, or Claude Desktop)

demoQueries.expectedBehavior: The MCP host's chat returns an answer grounded in your Glean content, with citations, proving the server is connected and authenticated.

demoQueries.query: Summarize our most recent incident review
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: The host returns a cited summary grounded in your own content — not a fabricated one. If it answers without citations, the MCP server is not actually being consulted.

steps.title: Detect installed hosts
steps.description: Check for supported hosts, then ask which one the user wants configured. Do not configure every detected host by default.

steps.title: Resolve your Glean backend
steps.description: Ask for the user's work email. Locate the installed cookbook plugin root from this skill, run its bundled resolver, and copy the returned backend value. The MCP server URL is <resolved-backend>/mcp/default.

steps.title: Configure the selected host
steps.description: --client values: claude-code, cursor, claude-desktop. This is the real, GA, first-party CLI for this job — it handles OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration by default. Don't hand-walk a Configurator URL or ask for an API token.

steps.title: Restart the host app
steps.description: Cursor and Claude Code pick up the new server on restart; Claude Desktop needs the hammer icon to confirm Glean tools are available.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Per host, ask "Who's on call for payments-service?" and confirm a real, Glean-cited answer.

aiPrompt: Detect the installed supported MCP hosts. Ask for the user's work email, run the cookbook plugin's bundled resolve-backend.mjs script, and configure each host with @gleanwork/configure-mcp-server using the returned backend plus /mcp/default. Do not ask for an API token when the default OAuth flow is available. Tell the user which apps to restart, then have them verify with a topic they know exists in their Glean instance.
llmContext: Use https://{instance}-be.glean.com/mcp/{server-name}; the default server name is default. Configure hosts with npx -y @gleanwork/configure-mcp-server remote --url <url> --client <host>. OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration is the default. Claude Code and Cursor connect over HTTP; Claude Desktop uses the CLI-managed mcp-remote bridge. Supply --token only when the host cannot use OAuth.
